description: This file implements the CyclicBuffer class, which provides a thread-safe, lockable circular buffer mechanism for inter-process or inter-thread communication. It includes methods for reading, writing, reserving space, locking, unlocking, and alerting based on data availability, and handles shared memory or file-backed buffers with cross-platform (Windows and POSIX) synchronization primitives.

classes.name: CyclicBuffer
classes.description: A thread-safe circular buffer class that supports concurrent read/write operations, reservation, locking mechanisms, and cross-platform synchronization. Used for efficient inter-thread or inter-process data exchange.

methods.name: bool Validate()
methods.description: Ensures the buffer and its control structure are loaded and valid, reloading if necessary.

methods.name: void AdminLock()
methods.description: Acquires internal mutex or semaphore to synchronize access to buffer control data.

methods.name: void AdminUnlock()
methods.description: Releases internal mutex or semaphore for control data synchronization.

methods.name: void DataAvailable()
methods.description: Virtual method that can be overridden to signal data availability; default implementation does nothing.

methods.name: void Reevaluate()
methods.description: Reassesses whether conditions for data reading/writing have changed and signals waiting agents.

methods.name: void Alert()
methods.description: Sets an alert flag and triggers reevaluation, notifying agents of a special event.

methods.name: uint32_t Read(uint8_t buffer[],const uint32_t length,bool partialRead)
methods.description: Reads data from the buffer into a provided buffer, handling buffer wrapping, and partial reads if enabled.

methods.name: uint32_t Write(const uint8_t buffer[],const uint32_t length)
methods.description: Writes data into the buffer from a provided buffer, handling wrapping, overflow control, and updating buffer pointers.

methods.name: void AssureFreeSpace(uint32_t required)
methods.description: Ensures there is enough free space in the buffer by advancing the tail pointer if necessary.

methods.name: uint32_t Reserve(const uint32_t length)
methods.description: Reserves space in the buffer for writing, managing concurrent reservations and process ownership.

methods.name: uint32_t Lock(const bool dataPresent,const uint32_t waitTime)
methods.description: Locks the buffer for exclusive access, waiting for data if requested and respecting timeout.

methods.name: uint32_t Unlock()
methods.description: Releases the lock acquired for exclusive access.

methods.name: uint32_t Peek(uint8_t buffer[],const uint32_t length) const
methods.description: Allows inspecting data without removing it from the buffer, respecting buffer wrapping.

methods.name: uint32_t GetOverwriteSize(Cursor & cursor)
methods.description: Returns the size of data that can be overwritten at the position indicated by the cursor.

methods.name: uint32_t GetReadSize(Cursor & cursor)
methods.description: Returns the size of data that can be safely read at the position indicated by the cursor.
